releaseNotes:
Phone v1.5.7

- Movie detail recommendations open on top of the current page, so the phone's
  Back button returns to the movie you opened first (not straight to Home).
- Tapping the Home search bar now opens the keyboard automatically.
- Trailer button lets you choose which YouTube app to use when you have more
  than one (with Just once / Always); opens directly when you only have one.
- Search remembers your recent searches — tap one to run it again, X to remove
  a single entry, or Clear all to wipe the list.
- Anything playing now PAUSES when you leave the app and RESUMES when you come
  back (live jumps to the live edge, movies/series pick up where you paused).
